mapper.select: SELECT si.issuer_code FROM rrs_securityinfo si WHERE si.wind_code = #{securityCode} AND si.issuer_code IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(si.issuer_code) != '' UNION ALL SELECT snap.issuer_code FROM ip_adjust_log log LEFT JOIN ip_adjust_security_snapshot snap ON snap.adjust_log_id = log.id AND snap.wind_code = log.security_code AND snap.is_deleted = 0 WHERE log.security_code = #{securityCode} AND log.audit_status IN ('00', '11') AND log.is_deleted = 0 AND snap.issuer_code IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(snap.issuer_code) != '' AND (log.pool_type IS NULL OR log.pool_type != 'crmw') UNION ALL SELECT snap.issuer_code FROM ip_adjust_log log LEFT JOIN ip_adjust_security_snapshot_crmw snap ON snap.adjust_log_id = log.id AND snap.wind_code = log.security_code AND snap.is_deleted = 0 WHERE log.security_code = #{securityCode} AND log.audit_status IN ('00', '11') AND log.is_deleted = 0 AND snap.issuer_code IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(snap.issuer_code) != '' AND log.pool_type = 'crmw'
SELECT si.issuer_code FROM rrs_securityinfo si WHERE si.wind_code = #{securityCode} AND si.issuer_code IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(si.issuer_code) != '' LIMIT 1

SELECT ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM rrs_securityinfo si INNER JOIN ip_pool_status ps ON ps.security_code = si.wind_code AND ps.audit_status = '20' AND ps.is_deleted = 0 WHERE si.wind_code = #{securityCode} AND (si.issuer_code IS NULL OR TRIM(si.issuer_code) = '') ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM rrs_securityinfo si INNER JOIN ip_pool_status_crmw ps ON ps.security_code = si.wind_code AND ps.audit_status = '20' AND ps.is_deleted = 0 WHERE si.wind_code = #{securityCode} AND (si.issuer_code IS NULL OR TRIM(si.issuer_code) = '') ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_adjust_log log LEFT JOIN ip_adjust_security_snapshot snap ON snap.adjust_log_id = log.id AND snap.wind_code = log.security_code AND snap.is_deleted = 0 WHERE log.security_code = #{securityCode} AND log.audit_status IN ('00', '11') AND log.is_deleted = 0 AND (log.pool_type IS NULL OR log.pool_type != 'crmw') AND (snap.issuer_code IS NULL OR TRIM(snap.issuer_code) = '') ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_adjust_log log LEFT JOIN ip_adjust_security_snapshot_crmw snap ON snap.adjust_log_id = log.id AND snap.wind_code = log.security_code AND snap.is_deleted = 0 WHERE log.security_code = #{securityCode} AND log.audit_status IN ('00', '11') AND log.is_deleted = 0 AND log.pool_type = 'crmw' AND (snap.issuer_code IS NULL OR TRIM(snap.issuer_code) = '') ) )
SELECT * FROM ip_adjust_security_snapshot_crmw WHERE adjust_log_id = #{adjustLogId} AND wind_code = #{securityCode} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT snap.wind_code , snap.issuer , snap.issuer_code , snap.rating_bondissuer , snap.rating_bondissuer_agency , snap.inner_issuer_rating FROM ip_adjust_log log INNER JOIN ip_adjust_security_snapshot snap ON snap.adjust_log_id = log.id AND snap.wind_code = log.security_code AND snap.is_deleted = 0 WHERE log.security_code = #{securityCode} AND log.audit_status IN ('00', '11') AND log.is_deleted = 0 AND (log.pool_type IS NULL OR log.pool_type != 'crmw') UNION ALL SELECT snap.wind_code , snap.issuer , snap.issuer_code , snap.rating_bondissuer , snap.rating_bondissuer_agency , snap.inner_issuer_rating FROM ip_adjust_log log INNER JOIN ip_adjust_security_snapshot_crmw snap ON snap.adjust_log_id = log.id AND snap.wind_code = log.security_code AND snap.is_deleted = 0 WHERE log.security_code = #{securityCode} AND log.audit_status IN ('00', '11') AND log.is_deleted = 0 AND log.pool_type = 'crmw' LIMIT 1

WITH companies AS ( SELECT issuer.s_info_compcode AS company_code FROM ais_inv_ods.wind_cbondissuer issuer WHERE issuer.s_info_windcode = #{securityCode} AND issuer.s_info_typecode IN (115004000, 115203000, 115200000, 115201000) AND issuer.s_info_compcode IS NOT NULL AND issuer.s_info_compcode != '' UNION SELECT issuer_code FROM rrs_securityinfo WHERE wind_code = #{securityCode} AND issuer_code IS NOT NULL AND issuer_code != '' )
SELECT CONCAT(c.company_code, ':', CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_pool_status ps WHERE ps.security_code = c.company_code AND ps.security_type = 'company' AND ps.target_pool_id = #{poolId} AND ps.audit_status = '20' AND ps.is_deleted = 0 ) THEN 'in' ELSE 'out' END, ':', COALESCE((SELECT MAX(log.id) FROM ip_adjust_log log WHERE log.security_code = c.company_code AND log.security_type = 'company' AND log.audit_status = '20' AND log.is_deleted = 0), 0)) AS context_value FROM companies c ORDER BY c.company_code

SELECT DISTINCT ps.security_code FROM ip_pool_status ps WHERE ps.security_type = 'company' AND ps.target_pool_id = #{poolId} AND ps.audit_status = '20' AND ps.is_deleted = 0 AND (#{companyCode} IS NULL OR ps.security_code != #{companyCode}) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ais_inv_ods.wind_cbondissuer issuer WHERE issuer.s_info_windcode = #{securityCode} AND issuer.s_info_compcode = ps.security_code AND issuer.s_info_typecode IN (115004000, 115203000, 115200000, 115201000) ) OR ps.security_code = (SELECT issuer_code FROM rrs_securityinfo WHERE wind_code = #{securityCode})) ORDER BY ps.security_code

SELECT COUNT(1) > 0 FROM ip_pool_status ps WHERE ps.security_code = #{securityCode} AND ps.target_pool_id = #{poolId} AND ps.audit_status = '20' AND ps.is_deleted = 0 AND (ps.adjust_type IN ('手工调整', '手动批量调整', 'Excel导入') OR (ps.adjust_type IN ('联动调整', '关联调整', '互斥调整') AND ps.adjust_batch_no LIKE 'BOND%'))
SELECT * FROM ip_grade_rule_alert WHERE security_code = #{securityCode} AND current_pool_id = #{poolId} AND rule_type = 'absCompanySync' AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE ip_grade_rule_alert SET fail_reason = #{failReason} , last_scan_time = NOW() , updt_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND alert_status = '00' AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE ip_grade_rule_alert SET alert_status = '99' , updt_time = NOW() WHERE security_code = #{securityCode} AND current_pool_id = #{poolId} AND rule_type = 'absCompanySync' AND alert_status = '00' AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id ,security_code ,security_short_name ,security_type ,adjust_type ,adjust_mode ,adjust_batch_no ,target_pool_id ,target_pool_name ,pool_type ,flow_id ,flow_key ,flow_type ,audit_status ,adjuster_id ,adjuster_name ,adjust_reason ,adjust_advice ,submit_time ,audit_time ,entry_time FROM ip_adjust_log WHERE security_code = #{securityCode} AND target_pool_id = #{poolId} AND adjust_type = '自动调整' AND adjust_mode = '调入' AND flow_type = 'absIdentityPending' AND audit_status = '00' AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE ip_adjust_log SET adjust_reason = #{adjustReason} ,audit_status = '20' ,audit_time = NOW() ,updt_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND adjust_type = '自动调整' AND adjust_mode = '调入' AND flow_type = 'absIdentityPending' AND audit_status = '00' AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE ip_adjust_log SET audit_status = '-1' ,audit_time = NOW() ,updt_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND adjust_type = '自动调整' AND adjust_mode = '调入' AND flow_type = 'absIdentityPending' AND audit_status = '00' AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE ip_adjust_log SET security_short_name = #{securityShortName} ,updt_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND adjust_type = '自动调整' AND adjust_mode = '调入' AND flow_type = 'absIdentityPending' AND audit_status = '00' AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE ip_adjust_log SET is_deleted = 1 , updt_time = NOW() WHERE id IN ( SELECT ps.adjust_log_id FROM ip_pool_status ps WHERE ps.security_code = #{securityCode} AND ps.target_pool_id = #{poolId} AND ps.adjust_mode = '调入' AND ps.audit_status = '20' AND ps.is_deleted = 0 ) AND adjust_mode = '调入' AND audit_status = '20' AND is_deleted = 0 AND (security_type = 'abs' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM rrs_securityinfo si WHERE si.wind_code = ip_adjust_log.security_code AND si.abs_flag = 1 )) AND adjust_type IN ('自动调整', '联动调整', '关联调整', '互斥调整')

UPDATE ip_pool_status SET is_deleted = 1 , updt_time = NOW() WHERE security_code = #{securityCode} AND target_pool_id = #{poolId} AND adjust_mode = '调入' AND audit_status = '20' AND is_deleted = 0 AND adjust_log_id IN ( SELECT id FROM ip_adjust_log WHERE security_code = #{securityCode} AND adjust_mode = '调入' AND audit_status = '20' AND is_deleted = 1 AND (security_type = 'abs' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM rrs_securityinfo si WHERE si.wind_code = ip_adjust_log.security_code AND si.abs_flag = 1 )) AND adjust_type IN ('自动调整', '联动调整', '关联调整', '互斥调整') )
